memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels, and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan. When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father's household gods. Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away. So he fled with all he had, crossed the Euphrates River, and headed for the hill country of Gilead." - Gen 31:17-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Jacob obeys God and sets out for home — that part is good and right. But notice the old patterns that still cling to this family even as they follow God. Jacob "deceived Laban... by not telling him he was running away," slipping off secretly rather than dealing openly. And Rachel, for reasons of her own, "stole her father's household gods" — small idols her family used in worship.

Here is honest reality. Jacob was heading in the right direction, obeying God's clear command, yet still leaning on his old habit of stealth. And Rachel, part of the covenant family, was carrying idols along on the journey. Obedience and lingering old ways were tangled together in the same household.

We can recognise this in ourselves. We may be genuinely following God in the big direction of our lives, while still holding on to old habits and hidden "idols" we have not yet let go. Growth in God is usually a process; the right direction does not mean instant freedom from every old pattern.

The good news is that God keeps working on us. In time, Jacob's family would have to bury those foreign gods and leave them behind (Gen 35:2-4). God patiently leads us forward, and along the way He asks us to lay down the idols and habits we have been quietly carrying.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What old habits still cling to me even as I follow God?
2. Are there hidden "idols" I am carrying that God is asking me to lay down?
3. Can I trust God's patient, ongoing work to change me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for leading me in the right direction. Show me the old habits and hidden idols I am still carrying, and give me grace to lay them down as I follow You. Amen.
